text:
Rep. Emanuel Cleaver promotes bipartisan BUDS Resolution and criticizes partisan distractions
C. L. Adams
Rep. Emanuel Cleaver, U.S. Congressman representing Missouri’s 5th district since 2005, addressed partisan divisions and legislative collaboration in a series of posts on September 2, 2026.
In his first post, Cleaver stated, "The American people are sick and tired of lawmakers putting partisan politics before the needs of their constituents. Today, I spoke to the Rules Committee about my BUDS Resolution and how it would help facilitate greater collaboration within Congress." (September 2, 2026).
He followed up by highlighting the bipartisan nature of his proposal: "The bipartisan BUDS Resolution I introduced with @RepYoungKim would help incentivize cross-party collaboration and meaningful lawmaking by encouraging members to work across the aisle. Find more information here: https://t.co/5y2lAKI6RT" (September 2, 2026).
Later that day, Cleaver criticized Republican colleagues for their focus on issues unrelated to domestic economic challenges: "While Republicans are wasting time insulting our neighbors to the north, the cost-of-living crisis continues to crush American families. @HouseDemocrats are fighting to end the chaos and lower costs for the people." (September 2, 2026).
Cleaver has served in Congress since replacing Karen McCarthy in 2005 and represents Missouri’s 5th District. Born in Waxahachie, Texas, in 1944 and currently residing in Kansas City, he graduated from Prairie View A&M University with a BS degree in 1972.
